# anthropic_service_account (Resource)

Manages a non-human Anthropic service account (`/v1/organizations/service_accounts`) used as a target identity for Workload Identity Federation (WIF). Requires an `org:admin` OAuth access token (`oauth_token`) or `federation` authentication. Deleting this resource archives the service account (`POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{id}/archive`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Slug name of the service account (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1-255 characters). Immutable after creation; changing `name` forces replacement.
- `organization_role` (String) Organization-level role assigned to the service account (`developer`, `user`). Admin service accounts can only be created in the Console.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the service account (up to 2000 characters).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was created.
- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the service account (`svac_...`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`service_account`).
